delusional · Nov 28, 2026

I just read google terms, which of them do you find unreasonable?

Google asks developers to self declare as "traders", which basically means "professional". If you're not a professional, these rules don't apply. If you are a professional, you need to provide them an address.

I find that very reasonable. If you are professionally selling software, you should probably have a place of business. Your customers should probably know where you trade from, and what jurisdiction you fall under.
